purpose.zh: 练握力，放松拉伸背阔肌
purpose.en: Build grip strength and lengthen the lats.

text.zh: 双手握杠，手臂伸直，身体自然下垂
text.en: Grip the bar with straight arms and let your body hang

text.zh: 身体保持安静，不要晃动
text.en: Keep your body still without swinging.

text.zh: 握不住前先踩稳再松手
text.en: Step down safely before your grip gives out.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.

cautions.zh: 确认单杠安装牢固，下方有落脚处
cautions.en: Make sure the bar is secure and you have somewhere to step down.
